Chicken Salan

.cook

this is a basic chicken curry that is made at home. My son loves it and if you have the ingredients it really is a less than 45 min recipe

🥘 Ingredients

  • chicken
    1/2
  • fried onion
    1 tablespoon
  • garlic paste
    1 teaspoon
  • ginger paste
    1 teaspoon
  • ground coriander
    1/2 teaspoon
  • ground cumin
    1/2 teaspoon
  • oil
  • potato
    1
  • red chili powder
    1/2 teaspoon
  • salt
  • tomato sauce
    1/2 cup
  • turmeric
    1/2 teaspoon
  • water

🍳 Cookware

  • pan
  • lid
  1. 1
    Get all your ingredients together.
  2. 2
    Add fried onion , garlic paste , ginger paste , red chili powder , turmeric , ground cumin , and ground coriander to a pan with oil and a little water . Add salt to taste. Cook for ⏱️ 3-5 minutes . Add water as needed to not burn.
    fried onion: 1 tablespoon, garlic paste: 1 teaspoon, ginger paste: 1 teaspoon, red chili powder: 1/2 teaspoon, turmeric: 1/2 teaspoon, ground cumin: 1/2 teaspoon, ground coriander: 1/2 teaspoon, oil, water, salt, water
  3. 3
    Add chicken and potato and cook for ⏱️ 15-20 minutes until the kushboo (good smell) comes and the chicken and potatoes have melded with the masala. Add water as needed so it doesn't burn and oil as needed so it fries. Add salt to taste and stir frequently.
    chicken: 1/2, potato: 1, water, oil, salt
  4. 4
    Add tomato sauce and cook for ⏱️ 5 minutes .
    tomato sauce: 1/2 cup
  5. 5
    Add water until the chicken and potato are covered. Cover with a lid and cook until the meat is done and the potatoes are soft.
    water, chicken, potato
